supersedes.reason: Independent review reproduced a nested manifest-name inventory bypass, media-type PDF downgrade, incomplete PDF xref validation, unsubstantiated per-item semantic features, and unconstrained control-file redirects. This manifest records the fail-closed corrections.

checks.result: The exact review-fix commit passed all 12 foundation commands and 80 foundation tests, including mandatory corpus validation, quality, generated-view integrity, and backlog validation.

Seven exact-commit focused tests passed, including regressions for nested control filenames, media downgrade, xref count/state/generation mutation, semantic-content replacement, and manifest/schema redirects.
The canonical corpus passed with 11 exact-inventory files, 20 substantiated features, three intentional rejection cases, and CC0-1.0 provenance.
The authoritative ledger and stored initial evidence validated with 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.

evidence: Only root manifest.json and manifest.schema.json are excluded from exact inventory; nested files with either basename are now reported as undocumented.

The manifest schema restricts supported media types, while the validator binds each suffix to its media type and each structural feature to compatible media and accept/reject outcomes, preventing a PDF from being disguised as text.
PDF validation now checks the declared xref count, exact entry count, free/in-use state, generation, object set and offsets, trailer size, and startxref target.
Per-item validation substantiates structured and plain scholarly sections, tables, citation markers, bibliographies, and RIS/BibTeX missing-field variants rather than trusting the feature labels.
Both root control files and all item paths must resolve to ordinary non-redirected files inside the corpus. The validator remains deterministic and offline.

The focused suite increased from five to seven tests and covers canonical content, hash/length tampering, licensing/inventory, nested excluded-name attacks, malformed fixtures, media downgrade, xref offset/count/state/generation attacks, semantic-content replacement, and control-file redirects.
The complete foundation suite increased to 80 tests and passes on the immutable review-fix commit.
The automation guide now documents exact root exclusions, control/item confinement, media and feature binding, full xref integrity, and per-item semantics.

The correction changes only the validator contract, focused tests, corpus schema, documentation, synchronized planning views, preserved initial evidence, and task audit state; no application or later-capability scope changed.
